title: Entity Consistency Checker
short: Find the entities you refer to by more than one name, and the ones Google has quietly merged into something else. No API calls, no cost.
needs: Nothing — it runs entirely in your browser
outputs: A cluster report you can export
how: Upload the entity export. The MID column is what makes this work.
Read the high-severity clusters first — those share an identifier.
Decide, per cluster, whether the variants are one thing or several.
Choose one canonical form and record it.
Leave case-only differences switched off unless you have a specific reason.
note: Not every cluster is an error. “Google” and “Google Cloud” are different things; “LLM” and “LLMs” are not.
